main_model_headline: 2. Decidable under the main model (gpt-5.6-terra): cktevo_risc__btb (1 design(s)); tally under the decided rule tie 1, undecided 6 (undecided rows are designs without the three gpt-5.6-terra rows). In the medium and small tiers the plan assigns gpt-5.6-terra only to M and B2 (config exp5.model_assignment.<tier>.second), so B0-terra, B1_E4-terra and DrRTL_reimpl-terra have no planned runs there at all; only the large tier runs every arm with gpt-5.6-terra.

criterion.criterion_text: C2: under hidden configurations at equal DC hours, M's geometric-mean gain exceeds B2's by more than 2σ_D on ≥ 60% of designs; M has an advantage of the same order over B1@E4 (otherwise the static prompt suffices); on Dr.RTL's 20 designs, M is not below Dr.RTL, or reaches the same level with ≤ 1/3 of the DC hours.

reachability.tally_basis: decided rule, main model gpt-5.6-terra, search basis, decidable designs only
reachability.note: the criterion is stated under the hidden configurations at equal DC hours; this report gives its visible-layer proxy (DECISION 2026-09-18 (d) F2) and, beside it, the pre-registered caliber on the visible layer — the hidden layer stays sealed until the Phase 5 completion marker

arms_note: Rows are never mixed across models. In the large tier the plan runs every arm with gpt-5.6-terra and M also with the contrast model; in the medium and small tiers every arm runs with gpt-5.6-luna and only M and B2 also with the contrast model (config exp5.model_assignment), so B0, B1_E4 and DrRTL_reimpl have no rows of the contrast model there at all. Large-tier M ran with the candidate prescreen on until 2026-09-18 06:25; medium and small M did not. The columns 'at equal DC' read every row's curve at the common budget (the smallest mean visible DC hours per run among the rows of the scope).

duplicates.archive_rule: M admits a candidate to the archive only when rule A labels it retained (src/search/driver.py: `if label == 'retained' ...archive.add`); the scalar arms admit any candidate with a positive component of their fitness (`scalar_improved`: any gain > 0), so their archives fill faster

sources.run scan: runs (exp phase5, status != superseded, excluded_from_tables = 0) with their candidates; labels from src.diagnose.m3.diagnose on the candidate's latest ok E4 record against D's E4 baseline (search basis: is_baseline = 1 at Φ_main; offline_saif basis: offline_baseline = 1 where it exists), with the frozen phase4 thresholds; the metric modes remove the other metrics from the record
sources.1 row completeness: src.analysis.phase5.complete_designs: the planned arm-model rows x seeds of every design (scripts/phase5_main.plan) against the runs with status done, and the candidates still pending a verdict, a simulation or an E4 record per row
sources.sigma_D: noise_floor (floor_version phase4, config E4): sigma_robust per metric with floor_source; a pooled row has no measured sigma_D (the design has no proven perturbation set)
sources.2 tallies: per design and arm-model row the per-run best retained gain per metric (0 for a run without one); the proxy takes their mean over seeds against the design's rule-A t_D, the pre-registered caliber the geometric mean of the gain ratios (exp(mean(log(1+g))) − 1; the plain geometric mean is printed beside it and is 0 as soon as a seed found nothing) against 2 σ_D of the design's perturbation set, read at the smaller of M's and the baseline's mean visible DC hours per run
sources.3 arm table: per arm-model row over the runs of the given designs: runs done, calls (runs.llm_calls), USD (runs.spent_usd), visible DC hours (evaluations.dc_seconds of the run's candidates and their envelope records), candidates, unusable answers (results/candidates/<run>/unusable_*.json), duplicates, inconclusive verdicts, proven, retained / trade-off by rule A at E4, best retained gain per metric per run (mean over seeds, max), and the same counts read at the common DC budget (the smallest mean DC hours per run among the rows of the scope)
sources.4 duplicates: candidates with label 'duplicate' (the run detected the same rewrite again: an identical E4 fingerprint of an earlier candidate of the same run, diagnoses.duplicate_of) against the run's calls; archive size per generation from gen_summary.archive_json (members); the correlation is Pearson's r over (run, generation) pairs between the archive size at a build and the duplicate share of the candidates issued in that generation
sources.5 failure forensics: candidates.verdict per arm (rejected = V1, sim_fail = V2, falsified = V3, inconclusive = SEQ inconclusive) and the equivalence records under results/raw/<design>/EQ/*/equiv.json: v1_detail for the V1 rejections, v2_detail ({signal: {c, d, first_cycle}}) for the lock-step mismatches; the D-vs-D record is the run of REQUEST (e) item 2 (d_saif group: c_rtl = d_rtl, same harness, same stimulus)
sources.mechanism: over the candidates of the complete designs (duplicates and aborted rows excluded, as in the retention counts): the rule-A fate of the proven ones, the parent of every candidate (candidates.parent_id NULL = D itself), the generation of each retained candidate, and — for M only — whether a verdict-derived feedback (a candidate of the SAME run and design diagnosed absorbed / noise / harmful) preceded it in an earlier generation; unverified-at-build from gen_summary.pending_json (src.jobqueue.core.unverified_at_build)
sources.7 per design: per design: tier, family, floor class and t_D per metric (frozen phase4 table), σ_D, the power basis of D's E4 baseline, the proven rate, each row's best retained gain per metric (mean over seeds and max) on both power bases, the outcome, and the class and evidence tags of the retained candidates that decided it

summary: 1. 7 designs are complete and 3 are complete except B0's offline E4; 8 have every row of their own tier's all-arms model complete, and 1 design(s) have the three comparison rows (M, B1_E4, B2) complete under gpt-5.6-terra.

2. Decidable under the main model (gpt-5.6-terra): cktevo_risc__btb (1 design(s)); tally under the decided rule tie 1, undecided 6 (undecided rows are designs without the three gpt-5.6-terra rows). In the medium and small tiers the plan assigns gpt-5.6-terra only to M and B2 (config exp5.model_assignment.<tier>.second), so B0-terra, B1_E4-terra and DrRTL_reimpl-terra have no planned runs there at all; only the large tier runs every arm with gpt-5.6-terra.

3. Excluded by construction (no arm produced a proven candidate): cktevo_hsm__hsm, drrtl_arm_cpu2, drrtl_tv80. All arms identical: rtlopt_sub_32bit, rtlopt_decoder_8bit. Decidable designs: cktevo_usb__usbf_sie_rx, cktevo_vga_enh__vga_wb_slave, rtlopt_divider_8bit, rtlopt_sub_32bit, cktevo_ethmac__eth_cop, cktevo_risc__btb, rtlopt_decoder_8bit.
4. Pre-registered caliber (geometric mean over seeds, 2 σ_D, equal visible DC hours), main-model rows: undecided (a row is missing) 4; undecided (no σ_D: pooled floor) 3.

5. σ_D exists (a measured perturbation set) on 17 of the 30 designs; on the other 13 the floor row is the pooled minimum, so the pre-registered separation cannot be formed and the design stays undecided in that caliber.
6. Reachability: 18 wins needed (60 % of 30), 0 in, 23 designs still open — arithmetically reachable.
7. At equal calls on the decidable designs, retained per run: B1_E4|gpt-5.6-terra 27.00, B2|gpt-5.6-terra 21.48, DrRTL_reimpl|gpt-5.6-terra 14.33, B0|gpt-5.6-terra 13.00.

8. Duplicate answers consume M|gpt-5.6-luna 31.0 %, M|gpt-5.6-terra 38.3 % of M's calls on the decidable designs, against B0|gpt-5.6-luna 8.1 %, B0|gpt-5.6-terra 1.7 %, B1_E4|gpt-5.6-luna 3.2 %, B1_E4|gpt-5.6-terra 0.0 %, B2|gpt-5.6-luna 3.1 %, B2|gpt-5.6-terra 5.8 %, DrRTL_reimpl|gpt-5.6-luna 17.3 %, DrRTL_reimpl|gpt-5.6-terra 8.3 %.

9. M's archive holds 0.95 members at a generation build against 2.3–2.6 for the baselines; the correlation between archive size and the duplicate share of the next generation is r = -0.06 for M rows and 0.14 for the baselines.

10. C2 cannot yet say anything about the hidden configurations (sealed), the small tier (no completed run) or the Phase 6 ablations (not run); the three things that would change the picture most are the remaining medium designs (20 open), the proofs of the 641 prescreened candidates, and the hidden-configuration evaluation.
